d: Long, flowing amethyst-purple hair with a side part falls past the waist, framing a mature face with a sharp, focused expression and glowing magenta eyes. The build is tall and slender with a grey-toned complexion, appearing as a demonic entity with long, black curving horns protruding from the head. The outfit consists of form-fitting, dark violet and black armor with sharp angles, featuring a long, flowing cape that transitions from deep purple to a bright, ethereal magenta at the hem. Holding a jagged, glowing magenta spear and a matching ornate shield, the entity possesses long, clawed fingers. BODY COLOR: grey LEGS: digitigrade with three-toed black claws
